title: Explicit NT K-streaming FP8 compensation has verified native-source headroom but is outside the resident Cake route

verified_by.CPU_gates: 180/180 unchanged Corpus; 2462 contracts passed, 26 environment skips; owned legal-refusal counterexamples

observation: The authored native Triton K-streaming source decodes two A elements and one B[N,K] column per K iteration, preserving FP32 Neumaier updates. Sealed job maca-0bd47e87cda7 passes all 37 NT v2 cases, 151552 output elements, with zero mismatches/max absolute error and unchanged inputs. Common paired MCPTI search maca-dcd7edef9ea0 and fresh confirmation maca-70d0d0104787 both pass the frozen quality gate: 250 samples per arm, pooled medians 22.784 us streaming / 155.904 us resident, 10/10 reversed-pair wins, 6.8427x on the fixed primary case. Baseline A/A job maca-4e54414a3aab passes quality with equal 155.904 us medians and ten ties. All 60 raw cohorts replay through paired_summary and native activity verification. Independent instrumented profiles report 26 versus 76 registers/thread, 0 versus 256 dynamic shared bytes, with correct instrumented outputs; bandwidth, instruction counters and achieved occupancy are not collected. Allocation is local_serialized, external activity not excluded. The legal public NT K1 Schedule is accepted structurally but the resident compensated contract refuses it with MACA_FP8_COMPENSATED_DOMAIN_UNQUALIFIED.
proposed_change: Implement a narrow explicit streaming lowering through existing NT tile-loop loads A[2,1], B[64,1] and FP32 result[2,64], retaining fixed global M=N=K=64, two-row program mapping and four execution groups. Preserve resident emission and numerical contract. Initialize and carry both FP32 total and correction at the owning K loop, finalize the corrected result at its legal live-out boundary, and refuse alternate writers, unsupported consumers, loop/tile domains or control commitments with the owning guard. Extend the existing compensated instruction only if its complete state/lifetime semantics and all analyses remain correct; otherwise make the precision/state contract explicit rather than hiding new global loads inside the resident emitter. No FP64 DType, layout algebra, new backend or direct FP8 dot is justified by this result.
principles: P1 uses existing range/load/mma authoring; P2 exposes K loads and compensation source/state; P3 keeps one canonical compensated contraction; P4/P5/P7 require correct typing, effects, lifetime and analysis coverage with emission; P6 requires generated positive and owned-refusal counterexamples plus unchanged resident/other-target sources; P8 binds software SIMT numerics and timing to the measured C550-2 runtime without inventing native FP8 matrix instructions or missing hardware counters.
promotion_disposition: Generated-source lowering accepted after complete all-case device and paired/A/A/fresh-confirmation/profile gates; exact primary benefit 5.80x, no generalization beyond the recorded domain.

generated_source_successor.observation: The real Cake streaming projection compiled through the isolated builder on C550-2 Triton 3.6 and sealed with two zero scratch pointers. All 37 NT v2 input distributions (151552 output elements) passed complete numerical comparison with max absolute error 0 and unchanged inputs. Paired search and fresh confirmation both pass quality and 10/10 reversed pair wins: 250 samples per arm, 26.880 us generated streaming / 155.904 us fixed resident baseline, 5.80x on primary. Baseline A/A passes quality with equal 155.904 us medians and ten ties. All 60 raw cohorts were independently reconstructed through native activity validation and paired_summary. Instrumented generated streaming output is correct; profile reports 20 registers/thread, zero static/dynamic shared and reported local bytes per thread 0, with bandwidth, instruction counters and achieved occupancy unavailable. This differs from the authored native source 22.784 us/26-register result; no substitution of evidence.
generated_source_successor.precision_and_domain: Existing compensated FP32 instruction, explicit A[2,1]/B[64,1] K1 loads, loop-owned FP32 total/correction and sole final live-out store. Fixed M=N=K=64, two-row program map, four execution groups and default single-stage non-unrolled control. No FP64 or new layout primitive.
generated_source_successor.promotion_disposition: Accept bounded Cake lowering and its exact fixed-primary MCPTI benefit. Preserve resident emission and fixed baseline. Allocation remains local_serialized with external activity not excluded; no GPU bitwise audit, direct FP8 dot, other-shape, framework/serving or general C550 speedup claim.
